snippet.title: Truxton II. [Arcade - Toaplan}.  (1992).  1CC. No Death - 1LOOP. 60Fps.
snippet.description:
. Tatsujin Ō / Truxton II. [Arcade - Toaplan}.  (1992).  1CC. 1LOOP. 60Fps.
.Played By PiE. - "May 23rd, 2021".
.
Wiki. - "a 1992 vertically scrolling shooter arcade video game originally developed and published by Toaplan in Japan and Europe. It is the sequel to Truxton, which was released earlier on arcades in 1988 and later ported to various platforms.".
.
